285. Replace with Greatest on Right

Problem Statement:
Given a number N followed by an array of N integers, replace every element with the greatest element on the right side(to that element) in the array. Replace last element with 0 as there no element on the right side of it. For example, if the array is {6, 7, 4, 3, 5, 2}, the output is {7, 5, 5, 5, 2, 0}.
input_spec: The input consists of a number N, followed by an array of N integers. N is less than or equal to 100000.
output_spec:
is {7, 5, 5, 5, 2, 0}.

Input Description:
The input consists of a number N, followed by an array of N integers. N is less than or equal to 100000.

Output Description:
The output is the modified array where each element is replaced by the greatest element on its right side, and the last element is replaced by 0.
